prereg.title: Budget-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Fact-Checking for Southeast Asian Languages
prereg.data: Open datasets only: SEBENARNYA-Fact v1.0 (ms), ViFactCheck (vi), X-FACT id/hi/bn/ta (verdict only), SciFact (en, source only).

hypotheses.H1: Hybrid retrieval (BM25 + BGE-M3) beats the best single retriever (chosen on dev) in macro nDCG@10 over the ms and vi test sets.
hypotheses.H2: Fine-tuned BGE-M3 beats zero-shot BGE-M3 in nDCG@10 on the paraphrased subset (low-overlap subset if no paraphrases are supplied).
hypotheses.H3: Multilingual GAINER beats the score-based cascade (Current Rank) in macro nDCG@10 at B = 0.50 under leave-one-language-out training.
hypotheses.H4: Verdict macro-F1 of the primary verdict model is lower with retrieved evidence (full depth, k = 3) than with gold evidence.
hypotheses.H5: End-to-end verdict macro-F1 with GAINER at B = 0.50 is non-inferior to full depth within a margin of delta macro-F1 points.
hypotheses.H6: Multilingual GAINER beats SEE (exit before block 0, threshold calibrated on source languages) in macro nDCG@10 at B = 0.50 under leave-one-language-out training.

tests.H1-H3, H6: Two-sided paired sign-flip randomisation test stratified by language; statistic = macro (over languages) mean per-query difference; Holm within F1.
tests.H4: Two-sided paired swap randomisation test on per-claim predictions; statistic = macro (over languages) difference in macro-F1; Holm within F2.
tests.H5: Supported if the lower bound of the stratified bootstrap 95% CI of the macro-F1 difference (B = 0.50 minus full depth) lies above -delta.
